steps.title: The proposals namespace is empty
before: The move took the record out of Dana's proposals namespace.

frame.title: dana@laptop: ~/example-project
frame.source: the AWS CLI help of `list-memory-records` and the output form of one live `retrieve-memory-records` run of the owner's first prototype; the record values are examples

after: A record has exactly one namespace. Approve made no copy.

learned: An approved record keeps its id and its text.
Its metadata names the author, the maintainer and the time of the approve.
From now on, every member of the project recalls it.
cannot: A record cannot be in the proposals namespace and in the shared namespace at the same time.
A person outside `example-project` cannot recall it. IAM denies that person a read of `/project/example-project/shared/`.
The approved record cannot carry a metadata key that Dana added herself. The core copies only the keys of propose.
notVerified: That the store keeps the text of a record after an update without text.
